issue: Gloss tense mismatch. Korean 올 거예요 is future, but English 'A typhoon comes tomorrow' uses present simple, which is unnatural for a one-off future weather event (cf. sibling card ko-1457 '오고 있어요 / A typhoon is coming'). Korean is correct; only the English needs fixing. Card also has no tip while the future -(으)ㄹ 거예요 it models is untaught here.

fix.english: A typhoon is coming tomorrow. Please be careful.
fix.grammar: -(으)ㄹ 거예요 (-l geoyeyo) = will / is going to: 올 거예요 = it will come.
